description: Family preset from plurano/horistes (Horistes is Greek for the boundary commissioner who fixes limits, pronounced ho-RIS-tees): default.json for every repository of the family. settings-sync.json is not extended: no gate holds rust-toolchain.toml to a settings source here.

pip-compile.description: Update the hash-locked lizard pin of tools/check_complexity.py by re-running the uv pip compile command its header records; the manager reads tools/complexity/requirements.in through that header.

pip_requirements.description: Off as the pip-compile manager documentation asks: that manager updates the .in source itself, and this one would bump requirements.txt without regenerating it from the source. The only other requirements file is praetor-managed and disabled below.

packageRules.description: praetor-managed files: praetorctl adopt ships their updates and praetorctl audit locks them byte for byte
praetor-managed engine: updates arrive in one coordinated adoption pull request

customManagers.description: praetor workflow engine commit pin: track the engine default branch
